newsitem.title: USA: Penwest extends shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Penwest extends shareholder rights plan.

text.p: Penwest Ltd on Friday said it extended the expiration date of its shareholder rights plan to June 16, 2008. The plan originally set to expire in 1998.
The chemical company said it amended the plan to strengthen the assurance that shareholders would receive fair and equal treatment in the event of an unsolicited takeover attempt.
The company declared its regular quarterly dividend of $0.05 per share, payable June 6 to shareholders of record, May 16.
Penwest makes specialty carbohydrate chemicals for paper-making, pharmaceuticals and specialty food ingredients.
